# dEQP-VK's pass list (scripts/ci-deqp-vk.sh, tests/page-deqp-vk.test.ts; docs/testing.md "dEQP-VK"): cases that
# pass on the page today, every one expected to pass. VK2 L5 (2026-10-26): the passing cases of samples of the direct
# set's groups (bench/gpu/deqp-run.ts vk with PREFIX, STRIDE and PASSED=1), the larger groups' thinned evenly; the
# failures, by cause, are docs/backlog.md's "The Vulkan driver's gaps". VK2 L7: the 8
# zero_initialize_workgroup_memory.specialize_workgroup cases past 256 invocations left, NotSupported on SwiftShader since
# what the device advertises follows its adapter (256 invocations a workgroup).
# VK3 L4c-D: the passing cases of dynamic rendering's basic group (suspended and resumed passes), its
# low_resolution_z.*suspend_resume and the load_store_op_none groups (KHR/EXT_load_store_op_none advertised), at the end.
# VK3 L4c-F: the passing cases of samples of 3D blits, 3D and non-renderable colour clears, storage images through
# descriptors, and every buffer-to-buffer copy and pipeline push-constant case (84 newly pass); the list regrouped
# so that each group's cases are together. Out: memory.allocation.random.* and memory.mapping.suballocation.random.*
# (7), which crash deqp-vk after enough earlier cases, with the renderer of before too (docs/backlog.md "Memory").
# VK3 L4f: the cases the out-of-context reviews' fixes (the cloud session's and L4f's) turn into passes, and the
# passing cases of the groups L4f sampled for them (indexed strips, storage images of cube views, inverted depth
# ranges, demote, depth and stencil input attachments, memory binding: 533 more, less the 7 below), in mustpass order.
# Out since L4f: samplemask_early_fragment_tests_depth_samples_4 (it passed while depth resolves were dropped; early
# fragment tests aren't honoured), multisampled 32-bit integer and two- and four-channel float formats (now not
# supported, as WebGPU has them), zero_initialize_workgroup_memory.max_workgroup_memory.* (crash deqp-vk in a long run).
# VK3 L5: real subgroups (WebGPU's, SwiftShader's size 4) and 16-bit storage: the passing cases of every 32-bit compute and
# graphics subgroups case (1,865 of 1,865 that ran; the large groups thinned to every third) and of every third
# 16-bit-storage case without 64-bit or I/O types (205 of 205), at the end.
# VK3 L6a: per-face stencil (a draw split by face where the faces' reference or masks differ), depth24plus-stencil8's
# stencil copied, occlusion queries counted on the GPU (their availability and strided copies): the passing cases of
# every 400th pipeline.monolithic.stencil case, of every query_pool.occlusion_query, fragment_operations.occlusion_query
# and query_pool.discard case, and of every third pipeline.monolithic.timestamp case, at the end.
# VK3 L6a, then: submits held for their timeline waits (the passing cases of samples of synchronization*'s
# timeline_semaphore groups) and DONT_CARE stored for a partial render area (every load_store_op_none case that passes).
# VK3 L6b: texel buffers (a storage buffer of the view's words and its format decoded in WGSL): the passing cases of
# texture.texel_buffer, binding_model.descriptor_copy's texel buffers, every twelfth binding_model.shader_access texel
# buffer case, memory.pipeline_barrier's texel buffers, every third api.buffer_view.access and every fourth
# api.buffer_view.create case that passes (of every eighth), at the end. Then depth and stencil copies WebGPU won't
# make (the worker's draws and compute passes; D24's copies advertised): every api.copy_and_blit.core buffer-image
# depth/stencil case and every fourth such image_to_image case that passes (81 of 544; 45 passed before), at the end.
# VK3 L7.1: Dawn's row (arrays of buffers and storage images indexed dynamically, sample-rate shading): the passing cases
# of glsl.opaque_type_indexing's ubo and ssbo groups (compute, fragment) and every third of its sampler group, and of
# the samples_4 cases of multisample.min_sample_shading*, multisample_shader_builtin's sample_id, sample_mask,
# sample_position, image_write_sample and write_sample_mask, and multisample_interpolation's sample and centroid
# consistency and sample_qualifier_distinct_values; and every sixth depth_stencil_resolve samples_4 case of SAMPLE_ZERO
# resolves that passes (s8_uint's stencil resolves fail: docs/backlog.md), at the end.
# VK3 L7.4: ANGLE's ES3 row: more than 12 uniform buffers a stage (past WebGPU's, read as storage): every
# descriptor_limits uniform_buffers case of compute and fragment shaders up to the device's 13, at the end. Then the provoking vertex
# (its last, through indices of the draw's own made before the pass; indexed fans the same way): every
# rasterization.provoking_vertex.draw case but adjacency's (not supported), and an indexed fan, at the end.
# Then transform feedback (the vertex stage run as compute at its pass's end; attachment-less passes given an
# attachment of the device's): the passing cases of transform_feedback.simple but queries, streams, indirect, multiview,
# geometry and tessellation (xfb_clipdistance's fail: docs/backlog.md), and of every third fuzz vertex case, at the end.
# VK3 L7.5: vkd3d's row (draw parameters: the push buffer's words past the push constants, an indirect draw's copied from
# its arguments before its pass): every draw.*shader_draw_parameters case that passes (60 of 76: draw_index's 16 are
# not supported without multiDrawIndirect), the two api cases of its feature, and the passing cases of every tenth
# draw.renderpass.instanced case (11 of 102; most need vertex attribute divisors, buffer device addresses or multiview),
# at the end.
# VK3 L7b: interpolateAtOffset and interpolateAtSample (the input moved along its derivatives): every samples_4 case of
# multisample_interpolation's offset_interpolate_at_pixel_center, offset_interpolation_at_sample_position and
# sample_interpolate_at groups, and sample_interpolate_at_single_sample's, at the end.
# VK3 L9b: integer textures sampled at an explicit LOD fetched from Vulkan's nearest level within the view's levels:
# every texturelodoffset and textureprojlodoffset clamp_to_edge isampler and usampler case that passes (35 more), at the end.
# VK4 T1: the census (every 100th case of vk-main.txt, bench/vulkan/REPORT.md "VK4 T1"): every case of it that passed and
# wasn't in the list (2,401; memory's random allocations left out, as above), in mustpass order, at the end.
# VK4 T2: the renderer's robustness. Every case that passes of api.external.memory's opaque_fd and dma_buf groups (the
# guest's export imported again aliases its memory) and of zero_initialize_workgroup_memory.max_workgroup_memory
# (Dawn's own zero-init on SwiftShader: deqp-run.ts), at the end. VK4 T19: memory.allocation.random and
# memory.mapping.suballocation.random (300), which pass since dead contexts' objects are destroyed and now fit: the
# renderer's arena is 1,280 MiB of memory 1, host-visible memory a 1 GiB heap of its own (242 MiB at their peak), at
# the end.
